verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document concurrency limits, rate limits, or queue behavior for batch rendering. The only related items are a marketing line about 'dedicated capacity with guaranteed throughput' for an enterprise tier and an FAQ note that multiple keys share quota. Neither specifies concurrency caps or how queued jobs behave, so they are adjacent at best.

support.subject: As a developer, concurrency limits and queue behavior for batch rendering are documented, so I can plan a production pipeline
